vol_dilation_ball — 2D 3d op

• Data kinds: volume → volume

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "vol_dilation_ball", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

Usage

3D binary dilation using a spherical structuring element. No corresponding HALCON op is specified.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

`a が球の半径を 1〜4（1+int(3a)）に振る。b は未使用。球は x²+y²+z² <= r² で作る（skimage.morphology.ball と同じ定義）。_vol_reg_dilate（6近傍固定）より広い近傍を扱え、a` で半径そのものを直接変えられる。
